findings.description: The agent briefly navigated to work key OL581793W (steps 11-15) even though the search results had already identified the correct work key OL893414W; it self-corrected by querying search.json, which returned the authoritative OL893414W record. findings.suggestedAction: Prefer reusing the work key already visible on the search results page when direct navigation is needed.
